_context.description: Parser configuration for IGVF CRISPR element-to-gene (E2G) tabular files loaded by CRISPR_element_gene_IGVF_adapter.py.
_context.layout_names: Top-level keys other than `files` and `_context` are layout definitions. Layout names (e.g. t_cell, crudo_tap_seq, pySpade) are shorthand identifiers reflective of each lab's internal naming for the experiment or analysis pipeline. These are not formal IGVF file-format terms.
_context.structure: Each layout describes column semantics and derived metrics for one file shape. The `files` section maps each IGVF file accession to a layout and file-specific options (e.g. targeted_element_types, skip_rows).

columns.p_val: P-value computed with MAST (https://rglab.github.io/MAST/). This method identifies differentially expressed genes between two groups of cells using a hurdle model
columns.avg_log2FC: log fold-change of the average expression between the two groups. Positive values indicate that the gene is more highly expressed in the first group
columns.pct.1: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the first group
columns.pct.2: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the second group
columns.p_val_adj: The percentage of cells where the gene is detected in the second group
columns.guide_id: gRNA ID of the selected / most significant perturbation per element and target gene
columns.target_gene: ENSEMBL ID of the tested gene
columns.intended_target_name: ENSEMBL ID of the element / TF promoter
columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of the element / TF promoter
columns.intended_target_start: Start coordinate of the element / TF promoter
columns.intended_target_end: End coordinate of the element / TF promoter

columns.FRACTEL_pval: Element-level p-values for the `intended_target_name` and `readout_gene` pair, as computed by FRACTEL (https://github.com/GersbachlabBioinformatics/FRACTEL)
columns.FRACTEL_pval_fdr_corr: Corrected FRACTEL_pval after applying the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure
columns.FRACTEL_effect_size: Element-level effect-size for the `intended_target_name` and `readout_gene` pair, as computed by FRACTEL (weighted average across guides within an element)
columns.intended_target_name: ID of the targeted element (grouping singleton measurements, like gRNA-gene p-values). In promoter screens, this column will contain the ENSEMBL ID of the targeted gene.
columns.intended_target_start: Start coordinate of the target element
columns.intended_target_end: End coordinate of the target element
columns.readout_gene: ENSEMBL ID of the readout gene

mechanoenhancer.notes: File format specification document reused from `t_cell` layout. Data file format does not actually match the fields defined in file format specification document precisely, i.e. ensembl_id instead of target_gene.

bulk_mechanoenhancer.title: MYH9 FACS screen results file format specification

columns.DHS_numeric: Numeric ID of the DHS - derived from guide grouping
columns.chrom: Chromosome where the DHS is located
columns.DHS_count: Number of guides used for that DHS (counts only minus strand guide)

fractel.title: Element-level FRACTEL Results

columns.dhs: DNase I Hypersensitive Site (DHS) genomic coordinates in the format chromosome:start-end (e.g., chr6:29702283-29703026). Identifies the regulatory element whose activity is being linked to gene expression.
columns.ensembl_id: Ensembl stable gene identifier for the gene whose expression is associated with the DHS (e.g., ENSG00000204574).
columns.gene_symbol: HGNC gene symbol corresponding to the Ensembl ID (e.g., ABCF1, ABHD16A).
columns.FRACTEL_effect_size: Effect size estimate from the FRACTEL model quantifying the magnitude of the regulatory relationship between regulatory elements and target genes. Positive values indicate that perturbations increase the expression level of tested genes; negative values indicate decreased expression of tested gene. We consider each element as having either a primarily positive or negative effect on the phenotype, and compute two directional weighted averages of effects using one-sided p-values p− and p+, taking the absolute maximum as the effect size of the element.
columns.FRACTEL_pval: Nominal p-value from the FRACTEL statistical test for the association between regulatory element and gene expression.
columns.FRACTEL_pval_fdr_corr: False Discovery Rate (FDR)-corrected p-value (Benjamini-Hochberg) for the FRACTEL p-value, adjusted for multiple testing across all element-gene pairs tested.
columns.intended_target_name: Name or coordinate string of the intended CRISPR perturbation target associated with this DHS (e.g., chr6:29702283-29703026). Typically matches the DHS coordinates.
columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of the intended CRISPR perturbation target (e.g., chr6).
columns.intended_target_start: Genomic start coordinate of the intended perturbation target.
columns.intended_target_end: Genomic end coordinate of the intended perturbation target.

fractel.notes: FRACTEL_effect_size is the weighted-average NB GLM Estimate from sc-crispr-de / FRACTEL (same catalog mapping as bulk_t_cell log2FC). These files are enhancer DHS screens; promoters are filtered out per submitter_comment.

crispr_surf.title: CRISPR-SURF File Format Reference

columns.FDR: The Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value threshold at which this region was called significant. One of the values supplied via the -padjs argument (defaults: 0.05, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001). A region that is significant at multiple thresholds appears once per threshold.
columns.Start: 0-based, inclusive start coordinate of the significant region (BED-style half-open convention). The region occupies [Start, Stop) on the chromosome.
columns.Stop: 0-based, exclusive end coordinate of the significant region (BED-style half-open convention). Region length in bp = Stop - Start.
columns.Direction: Sign of the deconvolved beta signal within the region. positive — sgRNAs in this region are enriched relative to controls (the targeted element promotes fitness or expression). negative — sgRNAs are depleted (the targeted element suppresses fitness or expression, or the region is essential).
columns.Deconvolved_Signal_Area: Area under the deconvolved beta profile across the region, computed as the sum of beta values at each base-pair bin within [Start, Stop). Larger absolute values indicate stronger or wider regulatory activity.
columns.Deconvolved_Signal_Mean: Mean deconvolved beta score across all base-pair bins within the region. Provides a normalised measure of effect magnitude that is independent of region width.
columns.Padj_Mean: Mean Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value of the per-base beta scores at positions within the region. Lower values indicate higher statistical confidence.
columns.Supporting_sgRNAs: Number of sgRNAs (of type observation) whose Perturbation_Index falls within the region or within the characteristic perturbation range of the region boundaries. Higher counts provide greater statistical confidence.
columns.Supporting_sgRNA_Sequences: Comma-separated list of spacer sequences for the supporting sgRNAs (in no guaranteed order). The count equals the value in Supporting_sgRNAs.

crispr_surf.notes: No readout gene, log2FC, or uncorrected p_value in this layout. Use file-level readout_gene. FDR is used only to keep the most stringent call per region. Stop is BED exclusive end and is used as-is. Deconvolved_Signal_Mean is SURF beta (effect_size), not DESeq2 log2FC.

columns.n_nonzero_cntrl: Number of gRNA cells with nonzero expression of putative target gene.

pySpade.title: pySpade DE table

columns.gene_names: The gene name of differential expressed gene.
columns.gene_name_ensembl: The gene name of differential expressed gene in ENSG format.
columns.chromosome: The chromosome where differential expressed gene is located.
columns.pos: The perturbation region in the screen.
columns.region: The perturbation region in the screen.
columns.intended_target_name: The name of the perturbed element (gene name or genomic region).
columns.intended_target_name_ensmbl: The name of the perturbed element (gene name or genomic region) in ENSG format.
columns.num_cell: The number of cells with perturbation sgRNAs. Note: if the perturbation region has multiple sgRNAs, all the sgRNAs are pooled together.
columns.log(pval)-hypergeom: Natural log p-value of hypergeometric test. This is the initial statistical test without considering background correction method.
columns.fc: The fold change of perturbation cells versus background cells. Bigger than 1 means up-regulation, smaller than 1 means down-regulation. It is calculated as: cpm_perturb / cpm_bg.
columns.Significance_score: Natural log p-value after background correction. Please look at pySpade's paper for more details about the statistical strategy.
columns.fc_by_rand_dist_cpm: The fold change of perturbation cells versus the selected background cells. Bigger than 1 means up-regulation, smaller than 1 means down-regulation.
columns.pval-empirical: The number of background selection whose p-value is smaller than the hypergeometric p-value. Please refer pySpade's paper for more detail.
columns.cpm_perturb: The cpm (counts per million reads) of the gene in cells with perturbation.
columns.cpm_bg: The cpm of the gene in all the other cells.
columns.log2fc: The Log2 of the fc (Fold Change) field.

pySpade.notes: Most fields from the data file are undefined in the file format specification document.

column_catalog_notes.log(pval)-hypergeom: Catalog raw p-value source. Stored natively as hypergeometric_ln_p_value; catalog p_value = exp(column). Initial hypergeometric test (perturbed vs all other cells) with no random-background correction.
column_catalog_notes.Significance_score: Catalog adjusted p-value (q-value) source. Stored natively as gamma_approximation_ln_p_value; catalog p_value_adj = exp(column). Gamma-approximation significance score modeling background and perturbation p-values (per pySpade / Yihan Hon lab).
column_catalog_notes.pval-empirical: Catalog field empirical_p_value. Empirical p-value comparing perturbation hypergeometric p-value to random background draws. Loaded into the database but not returned by the API.

pdx1_region_level.title: CRISPRi/a PDX1 Region-Level Results File Format

columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of the competent chromatin region
columns.intended_target_start: Start coordinate of the competent chromatin region on GRCh38
columns.intended_target_end: End coordinate of the competent chromatin region on GRCh38
columns.LFC: Estimated region-level log2 fold change in PDX1 expression associated with perturbation of the intended target region.
columns.IDR: Irreproducible discovery rate metric summarizing crossreplicate reproducibility; lower values indicate more reproducible guide-level signals.
columns.readout_gene_ensembl: Ensembl gene identifier for the measured readout gene.
columns.readout_gene_symbol: HGNC-style gene symbol for the measured readout gene.

pdx1_region_level.notes: No p-values (overlapping sliding windows). significant is derived from |z_score| >= ~1.96.

columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of targeted cis regulatory element.
columns.intended_target_start: Start coordinate of targeted cis regulatory element on GRCh38
columns.intended_target_end: End coordinate of targeted cis regulatory element on GRCh38
columns.response_ensembl: Ensembl gene identifier for the gene tested in the region-gene association.
columns.response_gene_symbol: Gene symbol for the tested expression readout.
columns.pass_qc: Indicates whether the region-gene test passed SCEPTRE quality-control requirements and produced an interpretable result.
columns.p_value: P-value reported by SCEPTRE for the region-gene association. Blank when the test did not pass quality control or was not evaluated.
columns.log_2_fold_change: Estimated log2 fold change in readout-gene expression associated with perturbation of the region. Positive values indicate increased expression and negative values indicate decreased expression.
columns.significant: Significance call produced by the analysis pipeline. Blank when the test did not pass quality control or was not evaluated.
columns.genomic_element: whether the tested cis regulatory element is distal or proximal to TSS
columns.promoter_gene_symbol: if the tested element is proximal to a gene TSS, the Ensembl gene identifier for the gene
columns.promoter_gene_ensembl: if the tested element is proximal to a gene TSS, the gene symbol for the gene

hs27_tf_perturb_seq.title: Norman CRISPRa Perturb-seq — File Format Specifications

columns.effect_score: Mean-population model coefficient (adata default layer). zscore units: standard deviations of change relative to control cells. Positive = upregulated; negative = downregulated.
columns.p_val: Nominal p-value from t-test on regression coefficient (adata layer: 'p').
columns.p_val_adj: Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted p-value (adata layer: 'adj_p'). Pairs with p_val_adj ≥ 0.05 are excluded.
columns.guide_id: Representative guide for this promoter element: the hit guide with the highest de_genes_fibro (number of significantly DE genes in fibroblasts, from adata.obs). One guide_id per unique promoter element. Hit guides are filtered to active_fibro or expanded_active_fibro (high-confidence transcriptional phenotypes).
columns.target_gene: Ensembl ID of the readout gene. Mapped from gene symbol via adata.var['gene_id']; version suffix stripped.
columns.intended_target_name: Ensembl ID of the regulated gene (per IGVF spec for promoter elements). Sourced from the ensembl column in merged_guides_promoters_UPSTREAM_PRIORITIZED.csv.
columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of the targeted promoter. Source: Chromosome column.
columns.intended_target_start: Promoter window start, 0-based half-open (BED). Source: promoter_start.
columns.intended_target_end: Promoter window end, exclusive (BED). Source: promoter_end.

hs27_tf_perturb_seq.notes: effect_score is a z-score (SD of expression change vs control), not log2FC. File already excludes pairs with p_val_adj ≥ 0.05.

multiome_perturb_seq.title: Norman CRISPRi Multiome Perturb-seq — File Format Specification

columns.effect_score: Mean z-scored expression of target_gene across the cells carrying guide_id, in standard deviations relative to control cells. Negative = downregulated. Note this is a z-score; the companion accessibility file reports a log2 fold change under the same column name.
columns.p_val: Nominal p-value, two-sided Kolmogorov–Smirnov test against non-targeting-control cells.
columns.p_val_adj: Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted p-value (adata layer: 'adj_p'). Pairs with p_val_adj ≥ 0.05 are excluded.
columns.guide_id: Guide identifier, {gene symbol}_{20 nt spacer}, e.g. ACTL6A_GCCCACCTCAGGCAACAAAG. Matches guide_id in the construct library’s guide table. 13 distinct values.
columns.target_gene: Unversioned Ensembl ID of the readout gene — the gene whose expression changed. Empty in 5 of the 14,868 rows, where the symbol-to-Ensembl lookup did not resolve a de-duplicated gene symbol.
columns.intended_target_name: Unversioned Ensembl ID of the regulated gene, per IGVF spec for promoter elements.
columns.intended_target_chr: Chromosome of the targeted promoter, UCSC-style.
